description:
"Let's get a divorce. You said it yourself. I was only meant to last three years."

She had fulfilled her role as a dutiful daughter-in-law and the duties of a lovely wife.    
Living only for the joys of marriage and the happiness of family, she had hoped for so much, but her husband did not.    

A kind and lovely woman.   
An affectionate wife whose eyes sparkled whenever she looked at him because she loved him so much.   
Even at the moment she turned away from him, she was so agonizingly beautiful that it set him ablaze.

"How can you talk about divorce when you love me this much?"
   
If he had respected and considered her as a spouse even for a single moment, it wouldn't have come to this.   
The distance of the past three years ultimately put a period on their marriage.   
The wife, who had held a unrequited love for her husband, now tries to let go of her feelings, but the husband is different.   

"Just because I'm crazy about you doesn't mean you can just blurt out whatever nonsense comes to mind."   
"Surveillance and attention, control and protection... it's all a matter of perspective."
